name: rejects a Verifier pass when a required check log changed after dispatch
reason: Rejects a real passed check only because its log bytes change; log content proof retired. Real failed/timeout/unknown check cases retained.

name: checks Archive acceptance once at each preparation, execution, and commit boundary
reason: Counts calls to removed document content-drift inspector; the repeated inspector policy is explicitly retired.

name: reads the finalized Archive report once and rejects later report changes
reason: Treats finalized human report edits, generated metadata edits and missing view as archive truth through reportSha256. Structured receipt/Run identity is tested separately.

name: rejects candidate drift after original gate observation %i before archive binding capture
reason: Both variants spy on the retired candidate fingerprint gate and create a normal implementation file solely to trigger automatic invalidation.

name: blocks unapproved %s changes after Archive preflight
reason: All three variants only create an ordinary hidden implementation file and expect automatic content-drift stop; no canonical spec.md conflict, user authorization change, request identity corruption or actual failed command is triggered.
